NoteRecord.title: NoteRecord
NoteRecord.description: A user's voice or text note with optional AES-256-GCM encrypted payload, multilingual voice setting, scheduled voice reminder, and small attachment boxes.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated note owner.

title.description: Note title or encrypted placeholder label.

content.description: Note body text or encrypted notice.

encryptedPayload.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted JSON bundle containing ciphertext, IV, and salt.

isEncrypted.description: Whether the note payload is encrypted with AES-256-GCM before cloud sync.

language.description: Voice dictation and TTS announcement locale.

reminderEnabled.description: Whether auto-reminder voice notification is switched on.

reminderTime.description: Scheduled ISO timestamp or local datetime string for the voice reminder.

reminderAnnounced.description: Whether the scheduled reminder has already been announced via voice note.

isCompleted.description: Whether the note or task item is marked completed.

attachmentsSummary.description: Serialized or encrypted metadata and compact previews for attached images and documents.

attachmentCount.description: Number of small attachment boxes populated on this note.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last updated.

/notes/{noteId}.description: Stores user notes synced across devices with AES-256-GCM encryption, multilingual voice dictation settings, attachment box previews, and auto-reminder schedules.
